question: Rashtriya Kalidas Samman was conferred to which of the following personalities in 2019-20?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunaina Hazarilal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sunaina Hazarilal

 
 
• Sunaina Hazarilal Agarwal is a well-known Kathak expert in India and is thought to be the last living member of the Janakiprasad Gharana of Kathak, also known as the Banaras Gharana.
 
• Sunaina runs the Natawari Dance Academy and is in charge of the Kathak department at the Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan in Mumbai's Sangeet and Nartan Shiksha Peeth.
 
• She received the fourth-highest civilian award, the Padma Shri, from the Indian government in 2011.
 
• She has been awarded the 2019–20 Rashtriya Kalidas Samman by the MP government for classical dancing.
 
• She also received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2003.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rashtriya Kalidas Samman**

 
 
• The **government of Madhya Pradesh in India annually presents the prestigious Rashtriya Kalidas Samman**.
 
• The honour bears **Kalidas name, a well-known author of Classical Sanskrit **in prehistoric India.
 
• In **1980**, the Kalidas Samman was** first given out**.
 
• Initially, it was awarded every other year in the **categories of classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts**. 
 
• From **1986-87 onwards**, the awards were** given out annually** in each of the four categories.
 
• The prize is given out in **recognition of exceptional performance in one of the four categories**.
